Deliverable (1): Universal Modular Weighing Architecture (`COMBI` & `DUO`)

Zero container electronics on detachable `DUO` bins (`≤30 m³`); drop-in rear shear pins on `COMBI` (`≤22 m³`).

Tier 1: SMART-Weight Lite€74 OEM BOM (±4.5%)

Bolt-on chassis strain gauge + hydraulic pressure-over-stroke work integral + 3-axis MEMS pitch/tilt compensation. 35-min field retrofit, zero crane needed.

COMBI: 2× rear roller dual-shear pins + 2× front elastomer pucks. DUO: Stationary rear wheel-pocket pads + locking-hook clevis shear-pins (solves clamp load-bridging).
